newsitem.title: USA: US attache raises Argentina soybean crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: US attache raises Argentina soybean crop estimate.

text.p: An agricultural attache posted at the U.S. embassy in Buenos Aires raised his forecast for Argentina soybean production to 13.5 million tonnes from 13.0 million tonnes.

"Although some delay in planting was experienced during the early part of the season, growing conditions have been favorable," the attache wrote in a report dated Jan. 31 that was released in Washington this week.
"This, combined with somewhat higher expectations of harvested area due to replanting, should result in greater production than previously forecasted," the attache said.
The attache pegged harvested area at 6.3 million hectares.
Attache reports are not official USDA data.
In its World Agricultural Supply and Demand Report released Jan. 10, USDA estimated Argentina soybean production at 13.00 million tonnes.
